title: Coffee table
guidance: Four legs are notched on their outer faces to take the long aprons, which run the whole length and are themselves mortised for two cross rails. The end aprons are tenoned through the legs and the long aprons and wedged outside; the top is four planks whose outer boards are recessed over the legs' 8 mm locating tabs, and the planks lock together through the aprons and rails. The top lifts off as four planks and fans open, which is how the frame's joinery is shown.

source.title: Coffee table
